name: n8n-hubspot-meeting-agenda-pre-brief-generator
description: Time-triggered pre-meeting intelligence for n8n and Node.js: finds meetings ~30 minutes out with external attendees, enriches them from HubSpot (contacts, companies, deals, notes, tickets), compiles an LLM executive brief with a deterministic fallback, and sends it to the assigned rep via Slack or email. DRY_RUN and SANDBOX_MODE are on by default.
author: DH Robin <robin@dhrobinsystems.com> (https://dhrobinsystems.com)
